"""Actual target parser and full BackgroundSession.Selection with explicit, unused Android IO fakes."""
import argparse,hashlib,importlib.util,json,os,shutil,subprocess,time
from pathlib import Path

def main():
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument('--source',type=Path,default=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2])
    p.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True)
    a=p.parse_args();source=a.source.resolve();out=a.output.resolve();out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('actual_background_selection_fixture',Path(__file__).with_name('prepare_fixture.py'))
    m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)
    files,extraction=m.prepare(source,out/'fixture')
    pkg=source/'src/org/trillionnium/hepta/local'
    files += [pkg/'BackgroundTaskTarget.java',pkg/'NotesOwnerIntent.java',pkg/'web/WebFlightGoal.java',pkg/'web/WebShoppingGoal.java',
              Path(__file__).with_name('BackgroundTaskTargetHostTest.java')]
    files=list(dict.fromkeys(files));classes=out/'classes';classes.mkdir()
    before={str(f):hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for f in files}
    compiler=shutil.which('javac');java=shutil.which('java')
    if not compiler or not java:raise RuntimeError('existing JDK required')
    stages=[]
    commands=[('compile',[compiler,'--release','8','-encoding','UTF-8','-proc:none','-Xlint:all,-options','-Werror','-d',str(classes),*map(str,files)]),
              ('target-selection',[java,'-cp',str(classes),'org.trillionnium.hepta.local.BackgroundTaskTargetHostTest',str(out/'CASES.json')])]
    env=dict(os.environ)
    for key in ('JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS','JDK_JAVA_OPTIONS','_JAVA_OPTIONS','CLASSPATH'):env.pop(key,None)
    for name,argv in commands:
        started=time.monotonic();r=subprocess.run(argv,cwd=out,env=env,capture_output=True,timeout=90)
        (out/(name+'.stdout')).write_bytes(r.stdout);(out/(name+'.stderr')).write_bytes(r.stderr)
        stages.append({'name':name,'argv':argv,'exit_code':r.returncode,'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-started})
        if r.returncode:
            (out/'RESULT.json').write_text(json.dumps({'all_pass':False,'stages':stages},indent=2)+'\n')
            print(r.stderr.decode('utf-8',errors='replace')[-12000:]);return r.returncode
    after={str(f):hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for f in files}
    if before!=after:raise RuntimeError('actual source changed during target checks')
    cases=json.loads((out/'CASES.json').read_text())
    if cases['all_pass'] is not True or cases['cases']<20 or cases['phone_actions']!=0:raise RuntimeError('target cases not complete')
    result={'schema':'hepta.background-owner-target-host-validation.v1','all_pass':True,'cases':cases,
            'compiler_contract':'Java8 API release','source_inputs':before,'source_inputs_unchanged':True,
            'stages':stages,'fixture':extraction,'android_runtime':False,'phone_actions':0,'preferences_written':False}
    (out/'RESULT.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps({'all_pass':True,'cases':cases['cases'],'assertions':cases['assertions']}));return 0

"""Compile the actual pure NotesOwnerIntent and fixed-payload validator, Java 8."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import time


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--source', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--release8', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    source, out = args.source.resolve(), args.output.resolve()
    if out.is_relative_to(source):
        raise ValueError('test output must be outside immutable source')
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    # The unchanged actual Owner grammar closure supplies the real authority compiler.
    names = ('NotesOwnerIntent', 'TaskAuthorization', 'ActionDecision', 'DecisionGrammar',
             'ObservedTargetLabels', 'ObservedAppLabels', 'ObservedScrollActions',
             'ObservedImeEnter', 'AppCatalogueRanker')
    files = [source / 'src/org/trillionnium/hepta/local' / (name + '.java') for name in names]
    files += [source / 'src/org/trillionnium/hepta/background' / (name + '.java')
              for name in ('FixedIntentTools', 'FixedIntentTarget')]
    files += [source / 'src/org/trillionnium/hepta/local/web' / (name + '.java')
              for name in ('WebFlightGoal', 'WebShoppingGoal')]
    files.append(source / 'tests/notes-owner-intent/NotesOwnerIntentHostTest.java')
    pins = {str(p.relative_to(source)): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in files}
    classes = out / 'classes'
    classes.mkdir()
    compiler = [shutil.which('javac')] if shutil.which('javac') else ['java', '-m', 'jdk.compiler/com.sun.tools.javac.Main']
    flags = ['--release', '8'] if args.release8 else ['-source', '8', '-target', '8']
    lint = '-Xlint:all' if args.release8 else '-Xlint:all,-options'
    stages = [('compile', compiler + flags + ['-encoding', 'UTF-8', lint, '-Werror', '-d', str(classes), *map(str, files)]),
              ('notes-owner-intent', ['java', '-cp', str(classes), 'org.trillionnium.hepta.local.NotesOwnerIntentHostTest'])]
    report = {'schema': 'hepta.notes-owner-intent-host.v1', 'phone_operations': False,
              'android_runtime': False, 'native_inference': False, 'source_inputs': pins,
              'compiler_contract': 'Java 8 API release' if args.release8 else 'Java 8 syntax/target only',
              'stages': [], 'passed': False}
    outputs = {}
    for name, argv in stages:
        started = time.monotonic()
        result = subprocess.run(argv, capture_output=True, timeout=60)
        (out / (name + '.stdout')).write_bytes(result.stdout)
        (out / (name + '.stderr')).write_bytes(result.stderr)
        outputs[name] = result.stdout.decode('utf-8', 'strict')
        report['stages'].append({'name': name, 'argv': argv, 'exit_code': result.returncode,
                                 'elapsed_s': time.monotonic() - started})
        if result.returncode:
            break
    passed = len(report['stages']) == 2 and all(x['exit_code'] == 0 for x in report['stages'])
    text = outputs.get('notes-owner-intent', '')
    case = re.fullmatch(r'NOTES_OWNER_INTENT_CASES=(\d+)\nNOTES_OWNER_INTENT_ASSERTIONS=(\d+)\n'
                       r'NOTES_OWNER_INTENT_PASSED phone_tested=false android_io=false model_io=false\n', text)
    report['passed'] = passed and case is not None
    if case is not None:
        report['cases'], report['assertions'] = int(case[1]), int(case[2])
    report['source_unchanged'] = all(hashlib.sha256((source / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == digest
                                     for name, digest in pins.items())
    if not report['source_unchanged']:
        report['passed'] = False
    (out / 'RESULT.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps({k: report[k] for k in ('passed', 'source_unchanged', 'phone_operations')}))
    return 0 if report['passed'] else 1


if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())
